results.rule_description: All features must have adequate clearance for manufacturing tool access
results.observation: The wireframe views (Top and Iso) reveal a large, fully enclosed internal cavity within the spherical head of the part. There is no visible opening or access path from the exterior, making it impossible for a tool to get inside to create this feature.
results.recommendation: The part must be redesigned to allow for the creation of the internal cavity. Options include: 1) Add an opening to the cavity. 2) Design the part as two halves (e.g., split vertically) that can be manufactured separately and then assembled.

results.rule_description: Prefer symmetric features to reduce setup operations and fixturing complexity
results.observation: The part's geometry, as seen in the Front, Top, and Right views, is symmetrical about its central axis. This is a positive design feature that simplifies setup and fixturing.

proposed_rules.look_for: Wireframe views showing internal cavities completely sealed off from the exterior.
proposed_rules.description: Avoid fully enclosed internal voids that make the part unmanufacturable by most standard processes.
proposed_rules.pass_criteria: All internal cavities have a clear opening to the exterior, allowing for tooling or material removal.
proposed_rules.fail_criteria: The part contains one or more fully enclosed internal voids with no openings.

proposed_rules.description: Avoid fully enclosed internal voids that cannot be accessed for manufacturing or post-processing.
proposed_rules.look_for: Wireframe views showing internal features with no corresponding openings on the exterior of the part.
proposed_rules.fail_criteria: The part contains a fully enclosed void with no access from the outside.
proposed_rules.pass_criteria: All internal cavities are accessible from the exterior via openings large enough for tooling, material removal (e.g., unsintered powder), or core/mold components.
